text:
alice: FYI a customer (acct: acme-corp) reporting intermittent 502s and timeouts from hosted inference API since ~08:12 UTC. Examples: 502 gateway, then 504 on retry.

alice: customer shows spike in 5xx from their side. They said it started after our 08:00 deploy but not 100% sure. Request ID: r-0a1b2c3d.

alice: attaching curl repro they ran:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam: looking. any logs from gateway or kv?

alice: I pulled the gateway trace for r-0a1b2c3d, shows upstream call to prefix-kv timed out after 2s then gateway returned 502. snippet: 
```
[08:12:42] gateway: route=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=prefix-kv timeout=2000ms err="upstream timeout"
[08:12:42] prefix-kv: conn=failed auth_err="NOAUTH Authentication required" dialing=0.02s
```

devon: tagging oncall @jordan. that NOAUTH from prefix-kv (redis) screams auth rotation or bad creds on the app side. I also see an alert from infra-bot: `kv-auth-errors > 5m`.

infra-bot: ALERT: redis-prefix-auth-errors (svc: prefix-kv) threshold breached at 08:11:58 UTC. 1m error rate = 11.3 err/min.

jordan: oncall taking it. starting triage: which customer prefixes impacted?

sam: quick query on metrics shows auth errors concentrated on prefix client:acme-* and client:partnerA-*. latency for prefix-kv read increased 10x starting 08:09.

jordan: steps: 1) confirm whether rotation job ran around 08:00 2) check KMS/HSM for recent key version 3) if widespread, flip kv-circuit to bypass prefix caching for hosted API routes.

devon: I see a key rotation event at 07:59:57 in secrets-manager logs: `rotate_key(prefix-kv-auth) -> v3`. The rotation completed but our credential refresh job had several failures due to transient TLS handshake errors to the KMS endpoint (see secrets-manager logs). Some pool connections were left with old creds.

jordan: ok that matches NOAUTH. mitigation plan: set prefix-caching to fallback mode so requests don't wait on prefix-kv auth failures. Can we apply a quick runtime override?

sam: yes. running the hotfix to disable prefix prefetch for inbound hosted API routes: `rwctl runtime set inference.prefix_cache.enabled=false --scope=hosted --until=2026-03-17T10:00:00Z`

infra-bot: ACTION: runtime flag applied by sam at 08:20:03 UTC: inference.prefix_cache.enabled=false (scope: hosted).

alice: customer reports error rate dropped to near zero after 08:22. They still see a few 502s but much fewer.

jordan: good. next: rotate creds on all pool clients to v3 and drain old connections. sam can you coordinate a rolling restart for prefix-kv client pool on the routing layer?

sam: starting rolling restart of prefix-kv client workers in 5 groups. progress: group1 done 08:25, group2 done 08:27, group3 done 08:29.

devon: I patched secrets-manager to retry KMS handshake on TLS transient errors; also forced a reissue of the new cred to the affected services.

sam: group4 done 08:31, group5 done 08:34. After group5, auth errors dropped to baseline and gateway 5xx rate normalized.

jordan: marking mitigation complete. we reverted runtime override? we should keep disabled until we confirm all clients are on v3.

sam: leaving override on until 10:00 as planned. I'll monitor.

alice: customer accepted workaround and will validate more load tests tomorrow. asked for RCA and whether this could affect other tenants.

jordan: RCA draft: key rotation v3 was created at 07:59:57. secrets-manager push to some prefix-kv client pools failed intermittently due to TLS handshake errors to KMS, leaving a subset of connection pools with stale creds -> NOAUTH on auth checks -> prefix-kv read attempts timed out or failed -> gateway returned 502/504. Contributing factors: insufficient retry and connection drain on cred change, runtime flag for prefix_cache toggling was not in runbook.

devon: remediation action list:
- Improve secrets-manager push reliability + exponential backoff and alerts for partial propagation.
- Add automatic client pool drain on credential rotation event.
- Add healthcheck that surfaces NOAUTH spikes into the rollout dashboard and flags in deploy flow.
- Add runbook step to toggle prefix_cache fallback and an automated safe-rollback for runtime flag.

sam: logging/observability followups: add metric `kv.prefix.auth_failure_rate_by_prefix` and break out 5xx upstream origin in gateway traces.

jordan: will create incident ticket and link to this thread. We should also notify sales/CS for impacted accounts. @alice can you file the CS note?

alice: filing CS note now and pinging account execs.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-1892 "prefix-kv auth rotation partial propagation -> gateway 502s" assigned to infra-oncall with priority P1.

sam: postmortem owner volunteers? i'll own infra fixes, devon will own secrets-manager fixes, jordan will own runbook + monitoring.

alice: thanks team. I'll keep the customer looped and follow up with the postmortem once it's ready. :thumbsup:

jordan: closing thread for now; will update with postmortem link.
